d:
West Bengal BJP MLA Rekha Patra was admitted to a private hospital in Kolkata after falling ill at her home. State Health Minister Sharadwat Mukherjee, who visited Patra at the hospital, said her condition was stable.
Patra, who represents Hingalganj in North 24 Parganas district, was first taken to a local hospital and later moved to Basirhat Super Speciality Hospital. Doctors there decided to transfer her to Kolkata.
